options.name: label
options.description: Visible label and accessible name of the group (via aria-labelledby). Must be a non-empty string.

options.name: hideLabel
options.description: Visually hide the label; it remains the accessible name.

options.name: value
options.description: Value (integer year 1-9999). The value passed to create() is the value restored by reset().

options.name: min
options.description: Inclusive lower bound (integer year; validation and popup). Must not be after max.

options.name: max
options.description: Inclusive upper bound (integer year; validation and popup).

options.name: name
options.description: Form field name; a hidden input carries the year as zero-padded YYYY.

options.name: description
options.description: Help text (text only) referenced by the group's aria-describedby.

options.name: required
options.description: An empty entry is invalid (value-missing); the segment is required and the required indicator is shown.

options.name: disabled
options.description: Disables the segment and the button; the popup does not open and the value is not submitted.

options.name: readOnly
options.description: Focusable and submitted, but not editable; the popup does not open.

options.name: validate
options.description: Consumer validation after the built-in checks; return a non-empty message to mark the value invalid (error 'custom').

options.name: isYearDisabled
options.description: Return true to disable a year: focusable in the popup but not selectable; typed, it is invalid (error 'unavailable').

options.name: today
options.description: Advanced: fixed today instead of the current date in timezone; it decides the current year. For tests, server rendering, and demos with a fixed clock.

options.name: icons
options.description: Icon slot overrides: calendar, previous, next, error.

options.name: validationTiming
options.description: When validation messages first appear; afterwards they update live.

options.name: closeOnSelect
options.description: Close the popup after a year is picked.

options.name: locale
options.description: Year formatting, headings, labels, and messages.

options.name: timezone
options.description: Zone used only to determine the current year (aria-current, default focus, and the start of stepping an empty segment).

options.name: direction
options.description: Popup and grid direction: grid arrow-key mirroring, chevrons, and popup alignment (applied when the popup opens).

properties.name: host
properties.description: Consumer host; its children are owned by the component. Registered with Form.

properties.name: group
properties.description: The labelled role=group with the segment and the button; control boundary and popup anchor.

properties.name: grid
properties.description: The role=grid of years inside the popup.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Current value; null when empty, incomplete, or failing a built-in check.

properties.name: validity
properties.description: { valid, error, message }; recomputed on every change.

properties.name: dirty
properties.description: Value differs from the initial value, or the segment holds an entry that does not parse to a value.

properties.name: touched
properties.description: Focus has left the whole control (segment, button, and popup) at least once.

properties.name: focusedValue
properties.description: The year holding the roving tab stop in the popup grid.

properties.name: current
properties.description: The year containing today in the configured timezone (or the today option).

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Programmatic value (no events); clears an external custom error. Throws YEAR_PICKER_OPTIONS for a value that is not an integer 1-9999.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge, validate, and apply options. Closes an open popup when it becomes disabled or read-only.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Open the popup and focus the selected year (or the current year), clamped to min/max. No-op when open, disabled, or read-only.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Close the popup; focus inside it returns to the button.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Show messages now (for every validation timing) and return validity.

methods.name: setCustomError
methods.description: External error (server, cross-field rule); null or '' clears it; cleared when the user edits.

methods.name: getFormValue
methods.description: Zero-padded YYYY, or null when the value is null.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Close, restore the initial value, and clear dirty/touched/submitted state (no events).

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Close, remove rendering, host classes, listeners, form registration, and subscriptions.

events.name: aui-change
events.description: The user changed the value or its validity error (typing, stepping, or picking a year).

cssClasses.name: aui-field__label | __required | __description | __error
cssClasses.description: Shared field chrome (the error is also aui-validation-message).

cssClasses.name: aui-year-picker__group aui-period-picker__group
cssClasses.description: Labelled group; control boundary, focus indicator, and popup anchor.

cssClasses.name: aui-period-picker__header | __heading | __nav | __prev | __next
cssClasses.description: Popup header: decade heading (aria-live) and previous/next 10 years buttons.

cssClasses.name: aui-period-picker__cell | --selected | --current | --disabled | --empty
cssClasses.description: Year cell and its states; --empty is the year-0 slot on the first page.
